typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		{SCRUBBED RULE} as string,
		FIRST_NAME as string,
		LAST_NAME as string,
		ADDRESS1 as string,
		ADDRESS2 as string,
		ADDRESS3 as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIPCODE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @CALLLISTDATE_IID BIGINT = ? SELECT M.MEMBER_MEMBERNUMBER AS MEMBERNUMBER, 	M.MEMBER_FIRST_NAME AS FIRST_NAME, 	M.MEMBER_LAST_NAME AS LAST_NAME, 	MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS1 AS ADDRESS1, 	MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS2 AS ADDRESS2, 	MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_ADDRESS3 AS ADDRESS3,  	MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_CITY_NM AS CITY, 	MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_STATE_CD AS STATE, 	MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_ZIP5 AS ZIPCODE, 	CASE WHEN ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID IS NOT NULL THEN ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD  		WHEN ICGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID IS NOT NULL THEN ICGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_CD  		ELSE NULL END AS [SCRUBBED RULE]  FROM PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = @CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER M ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID = M.MEMBER_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_MEMBER_ADDRESS MA ON M.MEMBER_IID = MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_MEMBER_IID 		AND MA.MEMBER_ADDRESS_TYPE_CD = M.MEMBER_ADDRESS_MAIL_TYPE 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 	LEFT OUTER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTGROUPRULE ICGR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID = ICGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID WHERE ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID IS NOT NULL OR ICGR.CALLLISTGROUPRULE_IID IS NOT NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ScrubbedMembers
ScrubbedMembers derive(MEMBERNUMBER = MEMBERNUMBER) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount derive({Convert.LAST_NAME} = toString(LAST_NAME),
		{Convert.FIRST_NAME} = toString(FIRST_NAME),
		{Convert.MEMBERNUMBER} = toString(MEMBERNUMBER),
		{Convert.ZIPCODE} = toString(ZIPCODE),
		{Convert.ADDRESS3} = toString(ADDRESS3),
		{Convert.ADDRESS2} = toString(ADDRESS2),
		{Convert.STATE} = toString(STATE),
		{Convert.ADDRESS1} = toString(ADDRESS1),
		{Convert.CITY} = toString(CITY)) ~> DataConversion
